stem.text: Which diagram shows the diffraction of water waves in a ripple tank?

A.alt: Straight wavefronts approaching a barrier with a gap from the left, with wavefronts drawn to the right of the barrier.

B.alt: Straight wavefronts approaching a barrier with a gap from the left, with wavefronts drawn to the right of the barrier.

C.alt: Straight wavefronts approaching a barrier with a gap from the left, with wavefronts drawn to the right of the barrier.

D.alt: Straight wavefronts approaching a barrier with a gap from the left, with wavefronts drawn to the right of the barrier.
